title: lysosome --json error
description: Printed on stdout instead of the normal document when a command run with --json fails (exit status 1; 2 for a command-line mistake). Added in 0.3.0.

code.description: Stable machine-readable reason. Known values: usage, no_valid_roots, no_home_dir, git_unavailable, thread_pool, io, needs_yes, needs_terminal, all_detectors_failed, action_log, picker, not_planned, internal. New codes may be added within a schema_version.
